turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good afternoon, I'm with the team that called about your water heater estimate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Have you looked at other options before reaching out to us?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Based on what we've walked through, the total price for this would be $4,200.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We were planning to shop around a little more first.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I understand, it is an investment. We do have financing options if that helps.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Why don't I send over the paperwork and we can follow up in a few days?
